eval_dimensions.name: Triage Before Any Write
eval_dimensions.description: permission_triage runs on the exact prompted command before anything is written, and every verdict other than grant ends the skill with the recommended fix instead of a write.

eval_dimensions.name: Grant Confirmation Gate
eval_dimensions.description: A grant verdict blocks on AskUserQuestion naming the rule, the target and the files, with Grant everywhere (Recommended) first, then Dry run only and Cancel — never a plain-text confirmation, never routed through resolve_gate.

eval_dimensions.name: Cancel, Dry Run and Task Closure
eval_dimensions.description: Cancel calls no further tool; Dry run reports the triage files_missing without calling permission_grant; the task is completed on every terminal branch.

eval_dimensions.name: Verify After Write
eval_dimensions.description: After permission_grant, triage is re-run and expected to return already-allowed; any file still missing the rule is reported by path.

evals.name: Plain command with no better fix is granted after the gate

assertions.signal: triage_called_with_full_command — permission_triage receives 'make test', not a hand-built rule
AskUserQuestion is called before permission_grant, lists the files_missing paths, and its first option is the only one labeled (Recommended)
echoes_rule — permission_grant receives rule equal to the rule permission_triage returned
reverifies — permission_triage is called again after permission_grant and the result is reported

evals.name: Cancel at the gate ends the skill
evals.input: Supervisor: /dev10x:permission-grant make test, then picks Cancel at the gate

assertions.signal: no_grant_on_cancel — permission_grant is never called after Cancel
task_closed — the skill's task is marked completed with a one-line report naming Cancel

evals.name: Dry run reports without the write tool
evals.input: Supervisor: /dev10x:permission-grant make test, then picks Dry run only at the gate

assertions.signal: dry_run_no_write_tool — the files that would change come from the Step 2 triage, and permission_grant is not called

evals.name: Command routed to an MCP tool is not granted

assertions.signal: names_route — output recommends the routed tool from advice (pr_get) and calls no write tool
no_grant_on_alternative — permission_grant is never called for a use-alternative verdict

evals.name: Interpreter command is not widened into a blanket rule

assertions.signal: explains_too_broad — output quotes the too-broad reason and calls no write tool

evals.name: Read outside the working directories gets a directory fix

assertions.signal: passes_working_dirs — permission_triage receives every session working directory as absolute paths
recommends_directory_or_read_rule — output offers additionalDirectories or a Read() rule and states a Bash rule would not help
explains_dx014 — output explains the prompt is kept on purpose and points at sensitivity-exceptions.yaml for one exact probe

evals.name: Missing target is resolved by diag-approval, not guessed

assertions.signal: delegates_target_pick — Skill(dev10x:diag-approval) is called and no target is guessed
